The '''Double Tag''' is a [[Tag]] that can be acquired either by skipping a {{Blind|Small Blind}} or a {{Blind|Big Blind}}. This tag starts to appear at [[Blinds and Antes|Ante 1]].

A Double Tag enables you to use it on your next skip, and gain the benefit of the skip multiple times, depending on how many tags you have.

Acquiring this tag would copy the next [[Tags|Tag]]. For example, if you skip both the Small Blind and the Big Blind on Ante has an {{Tag|Uncommon}} and then a Double Tag while holding a Double Tag, the Uncommon Tag would be duplicated by the Double Tag that you already have, while keeping the second Double Tag since it was obtained after the Uncommon Tag.

The Double Tag does not work on itself.

==Notes==
* Another way of obtaining a Double Tag is by selling the {{j|Diet Cola}}.
* Using the {{D|Anaglyph}} will give a Double Tag every time a [[Blinds and Antes|Boss Blind]] is defeated.
